findings.value: 98c Wallis Road, Main Yard, Hackney Wick

evidence.quote: Venue address is: Grow Hackney, 98c Wallis Road, Main Yard, Hackney Wick, E9 5LN
Venue address is: Grow Hackney, 98c Wallis Road, Main Yard, Hackney Wick, E9 5LN
Grow is an independent canalside cafe, bar, kitchen and grassroots music venue on the River Lea, serving Hackney Wick since 2014.
The inside bar area is wheelchair accessible with an accessible gender-neutral toilet.
There is no loop system for hearing aid users
Please find information on accessibility at GROW.

findings.value: Only the inside bar area and the side bar are wheelchair accessible; the terrace, greenhouse and mezzanine are reached by stairs (the access page gives 9 steps to the canalside). Main bar counter is 128 cm high and the side bar 102 cm. Assistance animals are allowed. Parking for access reasons must be requested by email well ahead, as the yard has automated parking restrictions. No BSL or live captioning unless an event page says so; ask hello@growhackney.co.uk about a specific event, ideally 72 hours ahead. Smoke and strobes are not usually used; email to check a date. The route from Hackney Wick station is level, with dropped kerbs, though tactile paving is limited.

evidence.quote: The outside terrace, greenhouse and mezzanine are not wheelchair accessible and can only be accessed via a series of stairs
There are 9 steps on the metal staircase.
The height of the bar is 128 cm.
Grow has a wheelchair-accessible bar on the side with a height of 102 cm.
Assistance animals are permitted, and bowls of water can be provided.
GROW can arrange parking for those who require it for access reasons. Please email hello@growhackney.co.uk to request this with as much notice as possible.
We do not have BSL or live captioning at events, unless otherwise specified on the event page.
We ask for as much advance notice as possible but ideally 72 hours to give us enough time to respond.
Strobe lighting is not usually used, but we ask if you have concerns to email us
Routes from Hackney Wick station to the venue consist of level-access enabled by dropped kerbs; however, tactile paving/detectable warning surfaces is limited.
Many events are free or low-cost.

findings.value: Ticketed events and door charges happen on some nights. After 9pm on Friday and Saturday, guests may queue and pay at the door, depending on the event. Card and contactless only, no cash. The main bar cloakroom costs £2 per item.

evidence.quote: Some events are ticketed or have a door charge.
After 9pm on Fridays and Saturdays, guests may need to join the general queue and pay for entry, depending on the event.
No. Grow is a cashless venue. We accept card and contactless payments only.
The cloakroom is £2 per item at the main bar.

findings.value: Under-18s may attend until 8pm with a parent or guardian at their table; most events are 18+ and Challenge 25 applies

evidence.quote: Under-18s are welcome until 8pm if accompanied by a parent or guardian and seated at your table.
Yes. Most events are 18+. Challenge 25 is in place, so please bring valid photo ID
